abstract: Maintains helideck technical compliance and winter instrument approach certifications
system_message:
You are the Aviation superintendent (AVS), responsible for maintaining helideck technical compliance and winter instrument approach certifications as well as monitoring aviation fuel storage for candidate subpolar marine research base stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aviation fuel storage（FUEL）
information_points.content:
AVS-FUEL-5N8：At Cape Adare Outpost, the usable Winter Jet A-1 reserve volume in the bunded aviation turbine fuel depot is 32000 L at the start of the polar season.
AVS-FUEL-RBA：At South Georgia Marine Facility, the usable Winter Jet A-1 reserve volume in the bunded aviation turbine fuel depot stands at 18000 L at the start of the polar season.
AVS-FUEL-OF7：At Falkland Sound Laboratory, the usable Winter Jet A-1 reserve volume stored in the bunded aviation turbine fuel depot is 24000 L at the start of the polar season.

information_points.title: Maintains helideck technical compliance and winter instrument approach certifications（DECK）
information_points.content:
AVS-DECK-UCP：Falkland Sound Laboratory holds an active Cold-weather helicopter deck rating, verifying that its elevated flight deck and de-icing systems meet structural and operational standards for Category A twin-engine rotorcraft in sub-zero icing conditions.
AVS-DECK-L0K：South Georgia Marine Facility does not hold a Cold-weather helicopter deck rating, as its elevated flight deck surface and de-icing matrix fail to maintain operational clearance for Category A twin-engine rotorcraft in sub-zero icing conditions.
AVS-DECK-61D：Cape Adare Outpost holds an active Cold-weather helicopter deck rating, with its elevated flight deck surface and de-icing matrix maintaining structural and operational clearance for Category A twin-engine rotorcraft in sub-zero icing conditions.
